title: The Value a Covered Piece Is Taken At under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans
content:
Where a claim is answered on a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans, the value the covered piece is taken at is read from any report standing on file for that piece with the Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services, against the validity of that report and the purpose it was prepared for.

Where a report stands on file for the covered piece whose validity has not run out and whose purpose of value is an insurance replacement, the piece is taken at the value that report states. Where a report stands on file for the covered piece whose validity has not run out and whose purpose of value is anything else, the piece is taken at the value it was sold at, at the other-purpose share the coverage allows, being 0.9 of that value. In any other case the piece is taken at the value it was sold at.

## Which value is taken

| Report standing on file for the piece | Purpose the report was prepared for | The value the piece is taken at |
|---|---|---|
| its validity has not run out | an insurance replacement | the value that report states |
| its validity has not run out | any other purpose | 0.9 of the value the piece was sold at |
| none on file, or its validity has run out | any | the value the piece was sold at |

A report whose validity runs to the handling date itself has not run out.

## Worked readings

A piece sold at 6000.00 USD with a current report prepared to state a replacement value for insurance at 7400.00 USD is taken at 7400.00 USD. The same piece with a current report prepared for another purpose is taken at 0.9 of 6000.00 USD, being 5400.00 USD, whatever value that report states. The same piece whose only report expired before the handling date is taken at 6000.00 USD.
